The date code on the label reads November 2024. The recalled date codes are only those produced from October 2023 through November 2023, so this unit is outside the recall.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial number, or payout account with this one.

No destruction photo is required for this remedy, and the claim requests repair or replacement, so no refund review applies.
